answer_2.quote: The experiment used three key evaluation metrics to measure the performance and robustness of the LLM agent. (1) Clean utility (CU) refers to the fraction of user tasks that the agent successfully completes in a benign environment without attacks... (2) Utility under attack (U) measures the agent's success in completing user tasks under prompt injection attacks... (3) Target attack success rate assesses the fraction of cases where the attackers goal is achieved...

answer_3.quote: Both instruction extraction (1) and ContributesTo score calculation within alignment check (2) leverage the capabilities of a large language model.
